findings.detail: Terminology continuity: source 'The only thing missing is the hat. The one he had worn in Paris' is the black baseball cap from the Prologue; RU 'Не хватает только шляпы' wrongly changes established baseball cap to a hat. Use 'кепки'.

Source end note uses first person 'Did I just write... Yes, yes I did' without stating author gender; RU 'Я ... написала ... я и сделала' adds unsupported female gender. Recast without gender-specific past tense while retaining playful tone.
